A '''signatory sponsor''' was one of the original corporations that signed the [[Corporate Sector Charter]] and created the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. They were also original members of the [[Galactic Corporate Policy League/Legends|Galactic Corporate Policy League]].
